description: This source file defines the BookService class which provides methods to fetch and search for books, retrieve book details, and obtain chapter content from a backend API as part of a book reader application.

classes.name: BookService
classes.description: A service class that interacts with the backend API to fetch book data, search books, and retrieve book details.

methods.name: listBooks
methods.description: Fetches a list of books, optionally paginated.

methods.name: searchBooks
methods.description: Searches for books matching a query string, with optional pagination.

methods.name: getBookDetail
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific book by ID.

methods.name: getChapterContent
methods.description: Fetches the content of a chapter or URL, potentially via a proxy.
